producer.draw_order: Vector chi2(df); vector standard_normal; vector chi2(df-1); ell ascending.

observer.monopole_and_dipole: Removed from angular spectra; monopole temperature reported separately as imported.
observer.instrument: Ideal full-sky noiseless observer with no beam smoothing.

statistical_model.label: Gaussian harmonic approximation using retained lensed TT/TE/EE two-point functions
statistical_model.sampling: One normalized 2x2 Bartlett Wishart draw at each ell, df=2*ell+1; TT/TE/EE drawn jointly.
statistical_model.intervals: Pointwise central 68% and 95% chi-square sampling intervals for TT/EE estimators at fixed theoretical spectrum; not parameter posteriors or simultaneous bands.
statistical_model.TE_sigma: Standard deviation from Gaussian-harmonic estimator covariance; TE estimator itself is not generally Gaussian and is not chi-square.
statistical_model.approximation: Lensing connected covariance and correlations between multipoles are omitted. This is not an exact lensed-sky realization.
statistical_model.interpretation: Conditional calibrated postdiction, not a new first-principles CMB derivation or a prediction of the actual phases of our sky.
source_interpretation: 3D dimensionless primordial curvature power, scalar passive adiabatic initial conditions, standard flat LCDM transfer.
Histories prepare an initial field and cease to be an active stochastic source by the matching epoch.
Background, matter content, recombination, reionization, amplitude and calibrated tilt are imported.
Every case recomputes transfer and nonlinear lensing; no stale transfer reuse.
The retained unlensed spectra provide a linear-transfer diagnostic. HMcode2016 nonlinear lensing is approximate and not validated for the UV-cutoff source.
No physical parameter or source cutoff is optimized against these outputs.

summary.rms_definition: sqrt(sum_{ell=2}^{2500} (2ell+1)*C_TT/(4pi)); no beam and truncated at ell=2500.

monopole.temperature_status: Imported Planck 2018 background parameter; not inferred from simulation data.
monopole.assumption: Ideal Planck blackbody; no mu/y or other spectral distortions modeled.
monopole.peak_definition: Maximum of B_nu = 2 h nu^3 / (c^2 expm1(h nu/(k_B T))); not B_lambda.
